topic: lubricate a dry, squeaky bike chain
core_question: How do I stop a bicycle chain from squeaking due to being dry? (secondary: Why isn't my garage door keypad working anymore, and how do I fix it?)
answer_summary: Wipe the chain clean of old grime, drip bicycle-specific chain lubricant onto each link while backpedaling, let it soak in, then wipe off the excess so it doesn't attract dirt.; after the topic shift: Open the keypad's battery cover and replace the batteries, which is the most common fix for an unresponsive wireless garage keypad.
